content:
maria: PTAL — addressed the comments on #486 (model-routing). split into two commits to keep the refactor isolated and added a short smoke script. sry for the churn, wanted to keep history.

maria: changes: updated routing table tests, tightened timeouts, moved the legacy fallback to a separate helper, added changelog entry.

maria: smoke script: `./devops/smoke_model_routing.sh` — runs locally and in CI, prints brief latency summary.

kevin: :eyes: quick skim — looks good. one tiny nit on the helper name (`fallbackHandler` -> `fallback_policy`) but not blocking.

sam: i'll run full integration later today. if tests pass i'll approve. can we add a brief note in the rollout doc about behavior if kv-cache is empty?

maria: added a line in the rollout doc under `behavior` and a short unit test that simulates cold kv-cache.

olivia: when do you want to schedule canary? we have a slot tomorrow morning but eng-sre wants heads-up.

maria: proposing canary 2024-10-03 09:00 PT. scope: 10% traffic, 4-hour watch window, fallback to previous stable model on errors.

jen: tagging eng-sre — @eng-sre could you confirm capacity for tomorrow 09:00 PT? also pls make sure tracing retention is on for the window.

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green (unit, integration, lint). build: 0.12.3

kevin: LGTM from me after the small rename or leave as-is if you'd rather not. :shipit:

maria: thanks! i'll rename and push a tiny follow-up. please approve when you can, planning to merge right after canary slot is reserved by ops.

sam: will recheck e2e later and approve if clean. otherwise ping me to hold merge.

maria: cool — will update here with canary reservation. :tada:
